verdict.rationale: Neon documents self-serve 'Instant restore' via branch/restore, which lets founders roll back a database without vendor support, satisfying the restore half of the story. However, there is no evidence of a traditional scheduled-backup mechanism with a visible/configurable schedule (Neon's architecture is continuous storage/branching rather than periodic backup jobs), so the 'schedule I can see and configure' part is unaddressed. Missing for 10: documentation of backup schedule visibility/configuration, retention policy controls, or backup frequency settings.
